sent_bad: Consent must be freely given: when assessing whether consent is freely given, utmost account shall be taken of whether, for example, the performance of a contract (including the provision of a service) is conditional on consent to processing of personal data that is not necessary for that contract.
A child who is at least 16 years old may give consent.

A child below 16 may give consent only if and to the extent that consent is given or authorised by the holder of parental responsibility over the child (Member States may set a lower age, but not below 13).
